The Slovenian Genealogical Index is an archival collection of data on persons and families in Slovenia, built from the collections of individual genealogists since the very beginning of the society's activities. In it you can search for the names and surnames of the people you are researching, to find out whether someone else may have already discovered and described them. The basic index contains personal names, dates and places of birth, marriage and death, as well as links to parents, partners and children. Each record also includes the surname of the contributing genealogist, which lets the researcher make further contact, points the way, and often makes research possible in a parish discovered indirectly. The contact details of the genealogists are not published, but they will not be difficult to reach through the Slovenian Genealogy Society.

The application offers advanced search, sorting, and data export options. For detailed instructions on using all features, please see the User Guide.

The family index can also include parents who never married or even never lived together – valuable information for descendants and other researchers.

The index is built from data in GEDCOM files contributed by many genealogists, listed on the Sources page.

The index also includes the Index of Parish Registers (baptisms, marriages, deaths). Several genealogists have already contributed indexes for entire books in individual parishes in CSV or XLS format. The list is available on the Matricula Index page.

The index also includes data from the Register of Slovenian Cemeteries, hosted on Geneanet. The list is available on the Geneanet Cemeteries page.

Warning! The Slovenian Genealogical Index is for informational purposes only. The Slovenian Genealogy Society disclaims all responsibility for the accuracy of the data submitted. The society is a voluntary association of individuals who together develop a shared knowledge source drawn from parish registers and other written and oral sources. Its structure allows anyone with their own collection of genealogical data to contribute it to the shared cumulative collection and index. Neither the individual contributors nor the Slovenian Genealogy Society can guarantee the accuracy of the data.

If you keep your own family tree in a database and would like to join the existing contributors with the results of your work, export the data to a GEDCOM file (without data on living persons) and send it to the administrator by email.
